expertise.text: Founded in Tallinn, Altmethods operates as a serious engineering contractor — not a niche climbing service. We hold IRATA rope access certification, comply with EN 365 and ISO 22846 safety standards, and carry full professional indemnity insurance. Our crews have completed projects in 14 countries, delivering to the same rigorous standard regardless of location.

questions.ropeAccessWhat: What is rope access, and when is it used?
questions.projectSize: What size projects do you take on?

answers.ropeAccessWhat: Rope access is a method of working at height using ropes and specialist safety equipment, allowing technicians to reach hard-to-reach areas without scaffolding or lifts.
answers.ropeAccessSafe: Yes. When the correct procedures are followed, rope access is a safe method of working at height: technicians use independent working and backup lines, certified equipment, and work under the supervision of a qualified supervisor.
answers.outsideEstonia: Yes. We work across Estonia and internationally. Tell us where your project is located, and we will confirm the timing and logistics.
answers.mobilise: We can mobilise to site quickly. Mobilisation times are agreed individually for each project.
answers.quotationIncludes: Our quotation sets out the specific scope of works, the cost of each stage, the timeline, and the conditions for organising the work at height. You know in advance what you are paying for, how the process will be organised, and what result to expect.
answers.projectSize: We carry out both limited-scope works at height and complex projects at large industrial and commercial sites. We assess the scale of each project based on technical requirements, the complexity of access, and the resources needed.

aboutPage.title: About Altmethods
aboutPage.subtitle: An Estonian engineering company specialising in technical works at height.
aboutPage.storyParagraph1: Altmethods OÜ was founded in Tallinn in 2024 by a team with backgrounds in construction, industrial inspection, and rope access.
aboutPage.storyParagraph2: We built Altmethods on a clear conviction: that rope access, applied by properly certified technicians, is a serious engineering method — faster, less disruptive, and often more economical than conventional access equipment. It is not a niche activity. It is the right tool for a specific class of problem.
aboutPage.regions: We work across Estonia and internationally. Tell us where your project is located, and we will confirm the timing and logistics.

irataNote.text: We hold IRATA rope access certification at all three levels, with regular competency reassessment.

portfolioPage.title: Our Projects
portfolioPage.subtitle: Technical works across Estonia and internationally.

serviceDetail.irataNote: All technicians certified to IRATA international standards. EN 365 / ISO 22846 compliant.

wind-turbine-inspection-and-painting.title: Wind Turbine Inspection and Painting
wind-turbine-inspection-and-painting.description: We carry out inspection and painting of wind turbines — towers, blades and nacelles — using certified rope access technicians. Regular inspection helps to detect surface damage and corrosion early, while protective painting extends the service life of the structure.
wind-turbine-inspection-and-painting.calloutText: Rope access gives technicians direct access to turbine towers and blades while reducing the need for cranes or lifting platforms. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Visual inspection of towers and blades
Detection of surface damage and corrosion

ndt-ship-inspection.title: NDT Ship Inspection
ndt-ship-inspection.description: We perform non-destructive testing (NDT) inspection of ships and their structures, including ultrasonic thickness measurement, visual, eddy current and penetrant testing. Rope access makes it possible to inspect areas at height and in hard-to-reach locations without extensive preparation.
ndt-ship-inspection.calloutText: Rope access allows NDT technicians to reach ship structures at height and in hard-to-reach areas without erecting scaffolding. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.

mine-inspection.title: Mine Inspection
mine-inspection.description: We carry out technical inspection of mine structures and equipment in locations that are difficult or unsafe to reach by conventional means. Inspections are performed by certified rope access technicians according to a written method statement.
mine-inspection.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to reach mine structures and hard-to-reach areas where conventional access equipment is impractical. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.

crane-installation.title: Crane Installation
crane-installation.description: We install cranes and crane components at height and in hard-to-reach locations. Rope access allows assembly and installation work to be carried out safely where scaffolding or lifting equipment cannot be used effectively.
crane-installation.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to work on crane structures at height and in hard-to-reach positions where other access methods are impractical. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Assembly of crane structures at height

pipe-shortening.title: Pipe Shortening
pipe-shortening.description: We carry out shortening of industrial pipes at height, including cutting and dismantling of the removed sections. All work is planned in advance and performed by certified rope access technicians.
pipe-shortening.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to work on tall industrial pipes without erecting scaffolding. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Preparation of the work area and method statement
Cutting of the pipe at the required height
Dismantling and lowering of removed sections
Finishing of the new pipe edge

installation-of-new-equipment-on-the-cra.title: Installation of New Equipment on the Crane
installation-of-new-equipment-on-the-cra.description: We install new equipment on crane booms and carry out painting works at height. Rope access allows the work to be done directly on the boom, helping to limit downtime and the need for additional access equipment.
installation-of-new-equipment-on-the-cra.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to work directly on the crane boom at height without additional lifting platforms or scaffolding. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Installation of new equipment on the boom

snow-removal.title: Snow Removal
snow-removal.description: We remove snow and ice from roofs and structures at height where conventional equipment cannot be used effectively. Timely snow removal reduces the load on structures and the risk of falling snow and ice.
snow-removal.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to clear snow and ice from roofs and structures at height where conventional equipment is impractical or unsafe. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Clearing snow from roofs and structures

absorber-cleaning.title: Absorber Cleaning
absorber-cleaning.description: We clean industrial absorbers and similar equipment in hard-to-reach areas. Cleaning is performed by certified rope access technicians, restoring the working condition of the equipment while limiting the need for scaffolding.
absorber-cleaning.calloutText: Rope access allows technicians to reach the surfaces of tall industrial equipment without erecting scaffolding. All technicians hold current IRATA certification. A written method statement and risk assessment are prepared before every job.
works: Cleaning of equipment surfaces at height
